To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the abnormality of trading behaviors before price jump can be effectively captured using a set of technical and liquidity related attributes.
The abnormal trading behaviors can be detected before stock price jumps by a new method based on the multivariate time series analysis.

(1) We propose a new framework based on multivariate classification technique to explore the trading related patterns in stock market; (2) Our analysis shows that several volume and volatility measures exhibit the most significant abnormalities before price jumps, and some abnormalities start much earlier than the occurrence of the price jumps; (3) We also find that our candidate attributes have relatively low mutual dependencies with other attributes, which allows various perspective to study the trading related patterns.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of abnormal trading behaviors detection and pattern recognition in the stock market before price jumps.
pattern recognition in trading behaviors based on multivariate times series classification, which is a new research area in the literature.
the following questions: What are the trading patterns before stock price jumps?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the abnormal trading patterns before price changes can be identified by the proposed time series classification method, and the trading behaviors of the abnormal stocks are significantly different from those of the normal stocks.

our study provides a new method for abnormal pattern detection based on multivariate classification and offers a new framework for trading related pattern detection using time classification techniques.
our study is able to provide a new framework and a set of jump indicator that can effectively detect abnormal trading patterns before price jump.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the abnormal trading pattern before price jumps is not only related to the liquidity measures but also related to the micro trading behaviors.

the abnormal trading behaviors before the occurrence of price jumps are not only limited to a single type of trading related attributes, and the abnormal patterns are more likely to start much earlier.

the trading related time series attributes can effectively reflect the abnormality of the market trading behaviors before price jump events, which can be used to construct jump indicators for abnormal trading pattern recognition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the time series classification technique can be used as a powerful tool for the pattern recognition problem.
the multivariate time series analysis is a powerful tool for studying the trading related pattern recognition problems.
the abnormal trading behaviors before stock market jumps are much more complicated than what has been found in the existing literature.
